output.summary: The 98.1% on-time figure is very likely inflated by metric gaming. Revisions rose fivefold only after the bonus took effect, at each center on its own start date (Pell Junction lagged until July). The mix shifted to Operational-Capacity reasons, late-timed revisions and unnotified customers. RouteWise brought fuel and mileage gains but no on-time analysis, and Northgate jumped before its go-live, so it does not explain the rise. Brightwell's receiving logs show 81%, down from 87%, and complaints rose 35% against flat damage and billing complaints. Suspend the claim and recompute against original dates (A3). Re-base the incentive (A4). Do not launch the campaign or raise the bonus. The driver-shortage role is unproven, so the $2.1M hiring plan is premature.
